quotes: "We captured all intermediate sketches and images they created during the experiment, and took detailed notes documenting participants’ comments and thought processes." (p. 7)

paper_code_entries.value: artifact — the numerical study assesses output quality and visible distortion (PDF pp. 8–9).
quotes: "Given a starting sketch containing both blocking and detail strokes and a text prompt, we generated images with both algorithms and asked users to rank them for overall quality and visible distortion." (p. 8)
"They preferred the quality of images from our algorithm over Scribble ControlNet for 84% of the pairs and found our images had less distortion in 81% of the pairs." (p. 9)

paper_code_entries.value: structuring — the tool organizes iterative work into blocking, detailing, and completion stages (PDF p. 9).
quotes: "Our tool, drawing inspiration from the progressive refinement typical in artistry, aids in this by structuring sketching into stages: blocking, detailing, and completion." (p. 9)

paper_code_entries.value: contingency — each partial sketch produces feedback for deciding the next update (PDF p. 1).
quotes: "After each sketch, the generated image samples serve as scaffolding for the user to decide how they might update their sketch by adding or adjusting strokes." (p. 1)

paper_code_entries.value: llm_or_foundation_model — Stable Diffusion and Dreamshaper diffusion backbones generate the scaffold images (PDF p. 5).
quotes: "We train our ControlNet on top of the Stable Diffusion 1.5 backbone [30]." (p. 5)

paper_code_entries.value: llm_era — the support is produced through contemporary text-to-image diffusion backbones (PDF p. 5).
quotes: "When testing our interactive tool with artists, we instead leverage the Dreamshaper 7 diffusion backbone [3], which is able to generate high-fidelity images with just 8 inference steps of the Euler-Ancestral solver." (p. 5)
